notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
1.1.0

New Features

Added Golden Squimbus
1/100 chance to spawn instead of a regular squimbus (1/10 in credits)
Has no other differences from regular squimbus other than appearance
Various Squimbus locations added
+5 in the hot biome  (Total of 6)
+1 in the cold biome (Total of 3)
Warning added when creating a new save

Fixes

Various small fixes and additions across all 3 biomes (including patching up The Hole)
Squimbus spawn locations & navigation radii adjusted to not overlap with walls or worldweeds
Bounceshroom & Melmee comics now appear as intended
Links between solar systems in the Chapter 9 Constellation now display properly
Fire Gas Planets now display properly in the to-do list
Fixed various almanac entries not unlocking properly
